annotations.title: Turn off a mailbox's report hook

description: Turn off bounce and complaint reports for this send-only mailbox and delete its secret. The service's next request is refused. Reports already received stay in the list for their last days. Needs `setup`: an owner's session or a whole-workspace key made by the current owner. A person's successful set or disable closes every pending, unexpired manage_report_hook request for this mailbox in the same transaction, even without its link. A key's write closes none. Without setup, ask the owner with create_handoff (kind manage_report_hook, with this mailbox's id).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
